guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 加入正北 Discord
guide.description: 加入正北 Discord。这是团队发布 TruthSayer 奖励公告和邀请代码的地方，也是目前获得推荐代码的唯一地方。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Join the TrueNorth Discord . This is where the team posts TruthSayer Rewards announcements and invite codes and is currently the only place to get a referral code.

guide.title: 在真北注册
guide.description: 访问 True North 网站并使用你的 Gmail 或 X 登录名创建一个帐户。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Visit the True North website and create an account using your Gmail or X login.

guide.title: 输入你的推荐码
guide.description: 输入推荐代码 ARDRPS。每个代码只能运行一次，因此在提交之前请仔细检查。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Enter the referral code ARDRPS . Each code works once, so double-check it before submitting.

guide.title: 设置你的交易角色
guide.description: 完成入职流程以设置你的角色。这会告诉人工智能代理你的风险承受能力和交易风格，以便你收到的信号实际上与你的交易方式相匹配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Complete the onboarding flow to set up your persona. This tells the AI agents your risk tolerance and trading style so the signals you receive actually match how you trade.

guide.title: 连接你的钱包和资金 Hyperliquid
guide.description: 转到“交易”标签页并连接你的钱包。 Hyperliquid 需要 5 USDC 最低首次存款，然后你才能签署让 TrueNorth 传送订单的构建器代码。如果你需要 USDC，请在 ByBit 上购买并将其发送到你的钱包或使用桥或交换资产 TrueNorth 以零构建器费用运行其 Hyperliquid 集成，因此签署构建器代码不会增加标准 Hyperliquid 交易费用之外的任何成本。跨链资金无需离开此页面即可在 30+ 链之间进行交换和跨链。路线快，费用低。立即跨链打开交互式桥组件在新标签页中打开跨链页面
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Your Wallet and Fund Hyperliquid
guide.original_description: Go to the Trade tab and connect your wallet. Hyperliquid requires a 5 USDC minimum first deposit before you can sign the builder code that lets TrueNorth route your orders. If you need USDC, buy it on ByBit and send it to your wallet or use the bridge or swap assets TrueNorth runs its Hyperliquid integration at zero builder fee, so signing the builder code adds no cost beyond standard Hyperliquid trading fees. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 通过人工智能代理进行交易
guide.description: 使用 TrueNorth 的代理命令，例如 /setup 和 /followup，获取交易想法，然后通过连接的 Hyperliquid 集成执行。交易量是最常与 TruthSayer Rewards 资格相关的指标。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Use TrueNorth’s agent commands, such as /setup and /followup, to get trade ideas, then execute through the connected Hyperliquid integration. Trading volume is the metric most often tied to TruthSayer Rewards eligibility.

sourcedDescription: TrueNorth has not confirmed a token or airdrop. There is no published tokenomics, distribution date, or eligibility list. What does exist is TruthSayer Rewards, a Discord-based program that pays USDC for trading volume, referrals, and community activity, with payouts that are not scheduled in advance.

What does exist is TruthSayer Rewards, a Discord-based program that pays USDC for trading volume, referrals, and community activity, with payouts that are not scheduled in advance.
